newsitem.title: CANADA: CFM Majestic to issue C$117.6 mln in shares.
newsitem.headline: CFM Majestic to issue C$117.6 mln in shares.

text.p: CFM Majestic Inc said on Monday it entered into an arrangement with a syndicate ofunderwriters for the public offering of about 5.6 million common shares of CFM worth about C$117.6 million.
CFM said about 2.5 million common shares from treasury and about 3.1 million common shares from certain selling shareholders will be included in the offer.
The underwriters said they will have a 30-day overallotment option to purchase an additional 500,000 shares from the treasury of CFM.
The pricing date is tentatively slated for late February and will be in the context of the market, the underwriters said. CFM shares closed on Friday at 21.00 on the Toronto Stock Exchange.
The deal is expected to close by about March 6, CFM said.
It said proceeds of the sale together with unutilized credit facilities currently in place will be available for CFM's acquisition program.
